title: Jio Finance Launches 'Finsider' Agentic AI Financial Super-App
summary: Jio Financial Services subsidiary launches Finsider super-app powered by Agentic AI and Neural Networks.

blocks.content: Jio Finance Platform and Service Ltd (JFPSL) launched **'Finsider'**, an Agentic AI-powered financial super-app offering loans, credit cards, insurance, UPI, and JioBlackRock mutual funds.
